TASK: Do not write any new text. The specification below was written for a writing experiment. It describes one formal pattern, abstracted from one existing literary passage (which is not shown) and from a critical reading of that passage; a writer was then asked to reproduce the pattern in a new setting. Identify the source: from which literary work, by which author, was this specification derived?

SPECIFICATION:
[C-P2-01] (MUST) from P_2: Embedded Italian metric verses
  Specification: One syntagm of the passage scans as a canonical Italian verse (novenario, settenario, or endecasillabo); the passage contains >= 3 total embedded metric units (novenario / settenario / endecasillabo) inside descriptive sentences. Verifiable by scansion (synaloepha and verso tronco rules apply).

Answer in exactly this form, and nothing else:
AUTHOR: <name, or UNKNOWN>
TITLE: <title of the work, or UNKNOWN>
PASSAGE: <which part of the work, or UNKNOWN>
CONFIDENCE: <a number from 0 to 100>
EVIDENCE: <one or two sentences: what in the specification led you to this answer>
